decision: Use for spatial coaching demonstration. Behavioral intent confirmed; the score-based research incumbent is not automatically promoted because the kill-margin interval includes zero.

contract.hypothesis: One rune owner plus occupied-route detours reduce contact and futile movement without sacrificing game score.
contract.score_guardrail: Report paired kill margin and win rate; do not claim stronger play without interval excluding zero.
contract.seed_unit: Average paired bank differences within each seed, then bootstrap independent seeds.
contract.metrics: Spatial samples every 8 ticks; body distance and low progress are proxies, not engine collision events.
